preconditions.description: The number of requests n must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 32 and name.islower() and name.isalpha() for name in requests)
preconditions.description: Each request name must be a non-empty string of lowercase Latin letters with a length between 1 and 32.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'OK' if name not in database else f'{name}{i}'
postconditions.description: If the name is not in the database, output 'OK'; otherwise, output the new name with the least available number appended.
The output must contain exactly n lines corresponding to the n requests.
